runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies **180 days after the memorandum is issued**. The memo's future-contracts provision says it covers any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance. It also covers any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after that same date.

The document is titled April 2025, so 180 days after issuance falls around October 2025. The passages I retrieved do not give an exact issuance date, so confirm that date from the memo itself.

The memo also does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
